name: Spark of Freedom
summary: The fire elemental has spent its strength in a blazing display. The Dark Irons held its attention, and the rest of the group is relieved it never turned on them.

sections.title: After the Flames
sections.body: The fire elemental's display leaves the onlooker amazed, then relieved when the creature runs out of strength. The Dark Irons had drawn its attention. Had it turned on the rest of the group, they too could have been in danger.

faq.q: What happened to the fire elemental?
faq.answer: The fire elemental ran out of strength after its pyrotechnic display.

faq.q: Who was the elemental going after?
faq.answer: The fire elemental had been going after the Dark Irons.
The onlooker is relieved because the elemental did not turn on the rest of the group.

attribution: In-game quest text: Spark of Freedom
